headline: Sensex Rallies as Nifty Holds Above 25,200 Driven by FII Inflows and Lower Crude

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Continued foreign fund (FII) inflows into Indian equities
Lower crude oil prices supporting market sentiment
Strong performance in major heavyweights like ITC, Asian Paints, and Bharti Airtel
Positive long-term market forecasts, including Morgan Stanley's Sensex target
whatHappening: Sensex gained over 300 points while Nifty held above the 25,200 level
ITC surged 3%, lifting the Nifty FMCG index higher by 1%
Laurus Labs fell 8% despite broader market gains
Tata Steel CEO announced expectations of stronger performance in H2 FY27
summary: Indian equities traded higher today as the Sensex gained over 300 points and Nifty held firm above 25,200. Broad gains were supported by sustained FII inflows and lower crude oil prices. Top sectoral gainers included FMCG led by ITC, while Laurus Labs slipped sharply.
